_comment: Feature inventory for scripts/compare-env.mjs (npm run compare).
Every entry is loaded on BOTH environments and compared side by side.
id     — short slug, used in filenames and the report anchor
name   — the feature label shown in the report
path   — path appended to each environment's base URL
auth   — true = only captured when the run is authenticated (--auth)
wait   — extra settle time in ms after networkidle (slow widgets)
note   — one line shown in the report saying what this entry covers
steps  — actions to walk INTO the screen before capturing. Without them a
route is compared exactly as it first lands, so a wizard shows only
its first page. Step forms:
{ "click": "English" }            button name, visible text, or a css/xpath selector
{ "fill": "input[type=email]", "value": "x@y.com" }
{ "waitFor": "Personal Details" }  wait for text/selector to appear
{ "wait": 1200 }                   plain pause in ms
Steps are read-only by design: click and type to REACH a screen, but
do not submit anything that would create data on production.
skip   — set true to park a route without deleting it
Add a feature by adding an entry here — no code change needed.
ignore — regex patterns for known third-party noise; matching console errors and failing requests are dropped before the diff.
